svg.title: Catch Up! — low-fidelity screen mock-up
svg.desc: Mobile-first wireframes: sign in and join, home list of catch ups, create wizard, invite and response status, personal availability and travel limits, options with map and list, option detail explanation, live voting, confirmed result, and profile defaults.
